response.sql: WITH oc AS (SELECT o.order_id, COUNT(i.invoice_number) AS cnt FROM Orders o LEFT JOIN Invoices i ON i.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY o.order_id), sh AS (SELECT order_id, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM oc) AS share FROM oc), av AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM sh) SELECT SUM(sh.cnt) AS total_invoices, AVG(sh.share) AS average_share, AVG(sh.share - av.avg_share) AS average_excess FROM sh CROSS JOIN av WHERE sh.share > av.avg_share
